title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension.

HPI
The patient is a 58-year-old male presenting today for a routine follow-up of hypertension. He reports that his blood pressure has been well-controlled over the last month. He denies any headaches, dizziness, or vision changes. He has been adherent to his current medication regimen and reports no side effects. He continues to engage in regular walking for exercise.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 25mg daily

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. He is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable with a blood pressure of 128/82 mmHg. Heart rate is regular. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No pedal edema noted.

Assessment
1. Hypertension: Stable and well-controlled on current medications.

Plan
1. Continue current medication regimen as prescribed.
2. Patient instructed to continue daily blood pressure monitoring at home.
3. Follow up in 3 months for routine check.

Problem List
1. major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate
explanations: Depression appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
